messages.subject: add_rownames returns data.frames
parts:
Hi All,

The new add_rownames function in dplyr 0.4.0 strips away the tbl_df and tbl classes. Should it?

Thanks,
Bob

> library("dplyr")

> mtcars2 <- tbl_df(mtcars)

> class(mtcars2)

[1] "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame"

> mtcars2 <- add_rownames(mtcars2, "Make&Model")

> class(mtcars2)

[1] "data.frame"
